name: Circle of Healing (Druid Circle)
body:
Your touch staves off pain and death, and your healing magic is particularly vital and potent.

Bonus Spells: cure light wounds (1st), cure moderate wounds (2nd), cure serious wounds (3rd), cure critical wounds (4th), breath of life (5th), heal (6th), greater restoration (7th), regenerate (8th), heal (mass) (9th).

Manifestation: You appear extremely virile for your age.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Skilled Healer (Ex)

Whenever you cast a spell that restores hit points to a living creature, it restores an additional number of hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier.

Spirit Boost (Su)

At 8th level, whenever your healing spells heal a target up to its maximum hit points, any excess points persist for 1 round per level as temporary hit points (up to a maximum number of temporary hit points equal to your class level).

Lifesense (Su)

At 16th level, you notice and locate living creatures within 30 feet, just as if you possessed the blindsight ability.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Aura of Life (Su)

(Grand Talent)

You and all living creatures within 30 feet cannot die due to hit point damage and automatically stabilize when reduced to below 0 hit points. Creatures below 0 hit points are still unconscious.

Protected by Life (Ex)

(Major Talent)

You gain death ward as a spell known, and when you cast it, the duration is 1 hour per caster level.

Rituals of Resurrection (Ex)

(Major Talent)

You gain raise dead, resurrection, true resurrection as 5th, 7th, and 9th level spells known, respectively.
